player_prompt.intro:
Kedda d-iklan {player_id} deg wari n HighSociety (wari n sin imawlan).
Aseqdec n wari:  Krad mertaban n prestij tuzzaltent yan udeffir n wayed.
Tuzzalt:    Yal asqdec, xerrez-d akeddi n tefrimt 1-11 d uffeg.
            • Tuzzalt tameqqrant tewwi-d takart n prestij d tettarez akeddi n tefrimt.
            • Tuzzalt tameẓẓyant tettarez akeddi n tefrimt-is.
            • Tie -> tuzzal tin d tin ttwaɣen d takart n prestij tin tettwazuɣen.
Aseqdec n wakal:    Seld n krad mertaban, rnu **akal ilik + uɣawas n prestij**.
            Aɣawas *amari* yewwi (tie tameẓẓyant -> aneɣlaf).

**Tasleɣt n tɣawsa**  →  tuzzal takart tameẓẓyant am '[7]' neɣ '[11]'.
